g.text: Complete Technical Architecture: Client Tier, API Gateway & Auth, Modular Monolith Backend, Data Store, and Extension Ecosystem
Layers: app, pages, widgets, features, entities
• Floating Now Playing Active Workout Bar
• Queued offline sync requests for gym mode
GoTrue JWT Bearer storage & HTTP interceptor
Delivery of 6-digit OTP login magic links
Strict Fallback JWT Bearer Auth Policy • User ID from IUserContext (Never Body/Query)
MediatR In-Memory Message & Domain Event Bus
Strict module isolation: WorkoutCompletedEvent, UserRegisteredEvent (No direct references)
• IDbConnectionFactory connection pool over PostgreSQL (No EF Core bloat)
• High-speed serialization & parsing of JSONB 3D logs & medical data
Automated SQL Migrations: Applied at startup and tracked in module-specific schema_versions
5. EXTENSION & FUTURE ROADMAP MODULES (Nix AI, Notifications, Billing & Observability)
• Local Quantized LLM (Llama 3 / Mistral via Ollama)
• Empathetic Coach persona for gym anxiety relief
Algorithm-only calculation for weights/reps (Zero LLM hallucinations)
• Anti-Churn Agent: detects stagnation after 3 sessions
• Habit Loop Retention: daily streak alerts & reminders
• Bridge Plan Celebration: unlock Home-to-Gym Plan B
• Local Scheduled Alarms for rest timer intervals
Stripe API & App Store / Google Play
• Freemium Access Controller: hard limit 8 sessions
• Feature gating: TUT metronome & Anti-churn agent
• Structured JSON logging with user context correlation
• Offline sync latency tracking in poor gym coverage
• Health checks (/health) for Docker Compose stack
• Zero PII / Anonymized telemetry per GDPR
